topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Well, would you look at that! Old Rolf, with his worn boots and parched fields, turns out to have a chest full of gold. Who'd have thought it? We all toil under the sun, shoulders stooped from the weight of the hoe, and there he stands, proclaiming his secrets of the earth. It's said he's been selling the finest wool to the merchants in the town, wools we never even knew he had. Some might whisper of envy, but I see a man who has worked his land with wisdom, perhaps richer in the blessings of the saints than in silver. Maybe there's a lesson here, hidden like the roots beneath the soil. Perhaps, if we tend our plots with faith and patience, we too might find our harvests rich and plentiful.
